description: Defines CUDA-specific device and stream guard classes for managing CUDA device contexts and streams, including CUDAGuard, OptionalCUDAGuard, CUDAStreamGuard, OptionalCUDAStreamGuard, and CUDAMultiStreamGuard.

classes.name: CUDAGuard
classes.description: Manages CUDA device context, allowing setting and querying the current CUDA device.

classes.name: OptionalCUDAGuard
classes.description: Manages an optional CUDA device context, supporting uninitialized state.

classes.name: CUDAStreamGuard
classes.description: Manages CUDA stream context, allowing setting and querying the current CUDA stream.

classes.name: OptionalCUDAStreamGuard
classes.description: Manages an optional CUDA stream context, supporting uninitialized state.

classes.name: CUDAMultiStreamGuard
classes.description: Manages multiple CUDA streams for context switching.

methods.name: reset_device
methods.description: Resets the CUDA device to a specified device.

methods.name: set_index
methods.description: Sets the current CUDA device by index.

methods.name: original_device
methods.description: Returns the device set at construction.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the guard to uninitialized state.

methods.name: original_stream
methods.description: Returns the CUDA stream set at construction.

methods.name: reset_stream
methods.description: Resets the CUDA stream to a specified stream.
